source: MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m v3, 32m overview level of the .ovr file
encoding: uint16 little-endian, row-major from the north-west corner; metres = base_m + value * scale_m
projection: equirectangular, centre longitude 0, sphere R = 3396190 m: x = R * lon_rad, y = R * lat_rad
place: All validation sites and the walk area, plus 20 km, clipped to the DEM
where_data_ends: The DEM rectangle ends 14 to 18 km east and west of every place and 16 to 22 km to the south (distance_to_dem_edge), so the 20 km radius is not reached there. Inside the rectangle the valid data is narrower still: the west and south-east margins are no data (nodata_fraction). Beyond either, no terrain is counted. The summit of Mount Sharp lies east of the DEM and is not included. tools/shielding.mjs reports, per point, the distance at which each ray ran out of data.
